specs.title: Dispatch Map Component

drifted.spec_text: System MUST use the ILogger receptacle for info, debug, and error logging throughout the component.
drifted.actual: Only logger.info(...) and logger.debug(...) are called; logger.error(...) is never invoked anywhere in the component, despite many Err-returning paths (KeyNotFound, Timeout, ActiveReferences, RefCountUnderflow/Overflow, InvalidState, InvalidSize).
drifted.location: components/dispatch-map/src/lib.rs (no logger.error call sites; error returns e.g. lines 130,165,203,232,250,270,290,315,340,415,458,519,558)

drifted.spec_text: Per-entry metadata is kept compact. The DispatchEntry struct size varies by Location variant (BlockDevice stores a u64 offset; MemoryTier stores a pointer, size, and optional offset).
drifted.actual: Location is a Rust enum, so DispatchEntry is sized by the compiler to fit its largest variant (MemoryTier) regardless of which variant is active at runtime; std::mem::size_of::<DispatchEntry>() (exposed via entry_size()) is a fixed constant, not a value that varies per entry.

not_implemented: User Story 1 / Acceptance Scenario 3 + Edge Cases item 1: create_memory_tier_entry does not reject a null pointer (no null check exists in components/dispatch-map/src/lib.rs:367-408; DispatchMapError has no null-pointer variant)

User Story 2 / Acceptance Scenario 4: lookup(key) has no expected-size parameter, so the ErrorMismatchSize / size-mismatch scenario cannot be triggered (FR-004 itself notes MismatchSize is 'not currently triggered')

unspecced.feature: promote_block_to_memory_tier(key, pointer, size) — in-place BlockDevice to MemoryTier promotion preserving reference counts and eviction handle; consumed by components/dispatcher and components/dispatcher-p2p for on-demand cold-block promotion
try_evict_to_block(key) — atomic evictability check plus BlockDevice transition under a single lock hold; consumed by dispatcher/dispatcher-p2p SSD-evictor paths
reuse_count: AtomicU32 field on DispatchEntry — incremented on lookup/take_read/downgrade_reference but never read or exposed via any IDispatchMap method
Formal-verification property claims (P1-P10, 24 verification conditions) referencing components/dispatch-map/verif/, a directory that does not exist under this component
